params.body:
Car-Pass changed its inflow specification (page version 160, 2026-11-09) ahead of the paid Car-Pass document of 2027-01-01. Three of those changes already apply to the Vehicle History Report flow the platform runs today. This brings that flow in line, and the Car-Pass document (#1083) will build on it.

## What changes

- **The report comes from `GET observation/{guid}/document`.** `status/vhr` is deprecated. The answer has the same shape (`file`, `publicUrl`, `unknownVehicle`, `validUntil`). `language` is NL, FR, DE or EN, and any other locale sends EN (it used to send `ES` for a Spanish session).
- **`documentStatus` is read.** A `PROCESSED` status with `documentStatus = NOT_AVAILABLE` (for example an issue confirmed a day late) is no longer fetched. Car-Pass asks not to fetch it and to show the reason. The dealer now reads `documentStatusReason` in their own language (Dutch for any language Car-Pass does not write), or the platform's own sentence when there is no reason. Before, the fetch got a 400 and the dealer read "carpass niet gekoppeld!". An answer without the field counts as available, as before.
- **A 4xx shows what Car-Pass wrote.** The documented error body is a list of `{field, message}`. `extractCarpassErrorMessage` cast that list's first object to a string, which throws. It now reads `field: message; field: message`.
- **The daily renewal no longer repeats a refused registration.** Car-Pass asks every supplier not to repeat a request that got a 4xx. `Daily::doUpdateOldCarpasses` picked the same expired cars every morning and sent the same registration again. Every stored step now keeps its HTTP status (`carpass_requests.http_status`), and a registration or correction keeps the chassis number and mileage it sent (`carpass_requests.sent`). The renewal skips a car whose last registration got a 4xx while those two are unchanged on the sheet. A 5xx does not block, and neither do rows from before this change. A dealer who clicks again is not stopped.
- `stocklist:carpass-smoke` uses the same path and prints the reason on `NOT_AVAILABLE`.

## Rules

New: R S3-2.26 (documentStatus), R S3-2.27 (4xx text, stored status), R S3-6.4 (renewal skips a refused registration), and R S3-8.10 / R S3-8.11 (what Car-Pass requires, quoted in `bronnen/car-pass-inflow.md`, now at page version 160). Updated: R S3-6.2, R S3-8.8, R P3-9.3. Open point O-21 is resolved.

## Not in this change

- The renewal still sends the mileage as it stands on the sheet. Car-Pass now requires today's mileage for a `VEHICLE_HISTORY_DOCUMENT` too, and an issue stays on the vehicle's history even after a late correction. What the renewal should do about that is a separate decision.
- A renewal that ends in an unanswered ISSUE (a 200, not a 4xx) is still sent again the next day.
- `NOT_AVAILABLE` is shown only in the dialog at that moment. It is not a chip in the list.

## Deploy

One migration adds two nullable columns to `carpass_requests`. Before relying on it in production, run `php artisan stocklist:carpass-smoke` on staging against the Car-Pass beta environment (the account in `CARPASS_USERNAME`). The tests fake Car-Pass; the new path itself has not been called against Car-Pass yet.

## Tests

`CarpassDocumentStatusAndRefusalsTest` (8 tests). The five existing Car-Pass test files fake the new path. The full suite is green locally, except `APhotoWithoutAForegroundIsNotAFaultTest`, which fails locally on `main` too and is green on CI. Pint passes on the added files.

Source: Portal mail:46.

Closes #1084
params.title: Car-Pass: fetch from /document, read documentStatus, do not repeat a 4xx
